text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both down sharply over 24 hours, with Ethereum's 6% decline outpacing Bitcoin's 4.1%, suggesting some profit-taking pressure across the major assets despite a firmly greedy sentiment index. BTC dominance at 58.8% and solid $102B in daily volume indicate the market has conviction behind this pullback rather than panic liquidation. Fear & Greed holding flat at 71 (Greed) over a week of losses points to resilient bullish positioning—traders are taking the dip in stride rather than capitulating.
